Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A greengrocer with herbs and baskets of vegetables. View: close cozy three-quarter view. Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. Dominant main colour: sage green (#8CAC71), clearly occupying the largest coherent surfaces, with balanced contrasting details. Composition is generic travel subject matter; NO recognizable destination landmarks, city names, signs, letters or logos. No UI or border. This is a finished clean plate for five separately painted motion details. Paint complete underlying surfaces at all five declared positions; do not draw the five named foreground details, leave no transparent hole or blank placeholder. Portrait master1280x1600. Part placements for later composition: a short scene-specific fabric pennant at normalised rect [0.13, 0.08, 0.22, 0.13]; a soft awning tassel at normalised rect [0.66, 0.23, 0.12, 0.18]; a small flower sprig matching the stall at normalised rect [0.74, 0.66, 0.16, 0.17]; a leafy branch entering from the left at normalised rect [0.06, 0.36, 0.17, 0.22]; a tied ribbon from one displayed package at normalised rect [0.41, 0.6, 0.16, 0.13]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts.
MANDATORY FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting with alpha255 everywhere; no transparent regions or translucent painted background. Refinement: A small intimate greengrocer shop dominated by muted sage-green painted walls, green counter and green awning, warm wicker baskets of carrots, aubergines, peppers and leafy vegetables, one little herb pot on counter. No sign, price tags, chalkboard, text, person or landmark. Clear coherent vegetable shapes and orderly attractive display, natural dimensional storybook detail. Darker desaturated green distinct from preceding bright turquoise. No UI, border, logo or lettering. This is a fully finished clean plate, portrait4:5.
